Exact algebraic and numerical consistency across all worked witnesses, Table 2 entries, and Figs. 1-3: e.g., Sec. 2 doubling proof for Lemma 3.3, cubic algebra for Prop. 4.2 (D_max = 414 for C11 and 18,492 for C12), Lemma 5.1 threshold (t^2+t-4)/2 < binom(t+1, 2), and C13 double-counting/Ramsey numbers (4000 >= 4000 > 3000 > 2660, |U| < 1540, |W| <= 16590420).
Constructive Lean 4.35.0 formalization without Mathlib, sorry, custom axioms, or Classical.choice, paired with an AST-audited zero-float Python rational verifier.
summary: This 4-page companion preprint to Linyuan Lu (arXiv:2611.33694v1) presents a constructive Lean 4.35.0 formalization (18 theorems, no Mathlib, no Classical.choice) and an AST-audited zero-floating-point Python certification suite (16 canonical JSON certificates C01-C16 and 36 tests) covering the finite primal-dual LLY curvature witnesses, algebraic inequalities, Hall-matching witnesses, and quantitative parameter regimes of Lu's resolution of Song's Problem 4.1. All visible algebraic derivations, primal-dual calculations (including Octahedron, K_6, and sharp join K_{t-1} v K_{n-t+1}_bar curvatures and K_t^{(2)}-freeness), Table 2 metrics, and Figures 1-3 check out accurately. Main limitations are inherent to the terse companion-note format: external density theorems [1,2,3,8] and Song's 2t*Delta^6 [7] are treated as unformalized hypotheses, the Lean/Python source artifacts reside externally rather than in the PDF, and a few prose summaries omit explicit parameter definitions or quantifier hypotheses (notably the t-vs-c relation in Theorem 10, E and s in Mode 4a, and which Delta enters Song's digit count in Table 2).
weaknesses: The 4-page PDF does not include the formal Lean 4 theorem statements from PosCurvCliqueCert.lean or the Python verifier/JSON certificate source, so a referee reading only the PDF cannot audit whether the Lean formalizations match Lu [5]'s exact hypotheses without vacuity.

Deep graph-theoretic components—the external density theorems [1,2,3,8], Song's global order estimate |V(G)| <= 2t*Delta^6 [7], and full graph-theoretic reductions of [5]—are treated as external hypotheses rather than formalized end-to-end in Lean.

Several terse summaries omit defining formulas needed for self-contained reading in the PDF, such as the Lemma 3.1 lower-bound formula producing d(y) > 7680000/1009 in C08 and the explicit pigeonhole inequality binom(b_I, 2) + b_I*(t - b_I) > b_I - 1 underlying the Mode 1b K_t^{(2)}-freeness split.
